name: gimme-the-lint
description: Polyglot progressive linting for monorepos — adapter-driven baselines, per-app drift detection, and idempotent skips. Supports JavaScript/TypeScript (ESLint, Biome), Python (Ruff), Go (golangci-lint), Rust (Clippy), Terraform/OpenTofu (tflint), and Ansible (ansible-lint).
